title: Care Service Directory - Implementation Guide
registry-description: Specifies the technical components of the Generic Functions programme for data exchange in Dutch healthcare, led by the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS). This guide covers Care Service Directory, based on the IHE mCSD profile.
registry-authority: Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
introduction: Specifies the technical components of the Generic Functions programme for data exchange in Dutch healthcare, led by the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS). This guide covers Care Service Directory (Addressing), based on the IHE mCSD profile, and Localization (Medical Record Localization) through the national Medical Record Localization Service (Nationale Verwijs Index, NVI).
desc: First publication at http://fhir.generiekefuncties.nl. Earlier versions were only available as CI builds (up to 0.9.0-ballot as hl7.fhir.nl.gf).
